Unfortunately, our experience with the hospital, apart from the doctors, was extremely disappointing.
The ICU environment did not meet our expectations. We observed visitors eating inside the ICU, and there appeared to be ongoing maintenance work, including painting, while patients were being treated. Some medical equipment seemed inadequate, and there was little effort to ensure patient comfort or properly manage personal belongings.

My family member remained in the ICU for 3–4 days before being shifted to a regular ward. After approximately 8 days, we were informed that she was fit for discharge. During her stay, she was on a urine bag, and there were occasions when it became full during the night without timely assistance from staff. For a private hospital, the level of care and attention was far below expectations.

After discharge, she developed severe swelling in both hands and legs. Multiple attempts to insert IV lines appeared to have caused significant pain, bruising, and swelling. As a result, she struggled to perform basic daily activities such as washing her face, using the washroom, and moving around independently. She required constant assistance from family members.

During a follow-up visit, we encountered issues with the billing department. Instead of addressing our concerns professionally, staff members became argumentative and suggested that the family was responsible for her condition.

They repeatedly stated that she had been walking normally at the time of discharge and that her current condition was not the hospital's responsibility.

What was most concerning was the behavior of certain staff members during the discussion. Voices were raised, and there was little regard for other patients and families present. No one attempted to de-escalate the situation or handle the matter calmly and professionally.

Overall, while the doctors were knowledgeable and supportive, the service provided by the billing department, nursing staff, and overall hospital administration was highly disappoint.

Unfortunately, the rest of our experience fell far below the standards expected from a private healthcare facility.

I hope the hospital management takes this feedback seriously and works towards improving patient care, staff behavior, communication, and overall service quality.
